raw_segments.text: I thought them so similar I could not tell where the old servant, for such I now concluded
her to be, saw the difference.
Both were fair complexioned and slenderly made, both possessed faces full of distinction
One, to be sure, had hair a shade darker than the other, and there was a difference in their
Mary's pale brown locks were parted and braided smooth.
Diana's duskier tresses covered her neck with thick curls.
